```artifact
Feature: System Access and Management

  Scenario Outline: System availability based on PinCodes
    Given the system is configured with the following PinCodes: <pinCodes>
    When a user tries to access the system with PinCode: <pinCode>
    Then the system should <beAvailable|beUnavailable>

    Examples:
      | pinCodes | pinCode | beAvailable |
      | 1234,5678 | 1234 | true |
      | 1234,5678 | 5678 | true |
      | 1234,5678 | 9999 | false |

  Scenario Outline: User login with valid credentials
    Given the system is configured with the following users:
      | userId | password |
      | user1  | pass1    |
      | user2  | pass2    |
    When a user tries to login with userId: <userId> and password: <password>
    Then the login should <succeed|fail>

    Examples:
      | userId | password | succeed |
      | user1  | pass1    | true    |
      | user2  | pass2    | true    |
      | user1  | wrongPass| false   |
      | user3  | pass1    | false   |

  Scenario Outline: Doctor-Speciality mapping
    Given the system is configured with the following Specialties and Doctors:
      | specialty | doctor |
      | Cardiology | Dr. Smith |
      | Pediatrics | Dr. Johnson |
    When a doctor tries to provide consultation for Specialty: <specialty>
    Then the doctor should be mapped to <specialty>

    Examples:
      | specialty | doctor    |
      | Cardiology | Dr. Smith |
      | Pediatrics | Dr. Johnson |

  Scenario Outline: Patient registration
    Given the system is configured
    When a patient registers with the following details:
      | name | age | gender |
      | John | 30  | Male   |
    Then a unique Patient ID should be generated for the patient

    Examples:
      | name | age | gender | uniqueId |
      | John | 30  | Male   | as specified |

  Scenario Outline: Consultation request
    Given the system is configured with the following Patients and Specialties:
      | patient | specialty |
      | Patient1| Cardiology|
    When a patient requests consultation for Specialty: <specialty>
    Then the consultation request should be linked to <specialty>

    Examples:
      | patient | specialty | linked |
      | Patient1| Cardiology| true   |
```
